requested_delta: Extend the existing Primary Chat mirror/publication harness with one fail-closed representative Chromium lane after validated gh-pages publication and served-byte identity. Persist browser evidence without creating a new workflow family, publication owner, scheduler, acceptance authority or promotion authority.
must_preserve: Existing return reconciliation, atomic mirror semantics and asset versioning gate remain mandatory.
Existing gh-pages publication stays non-force and rebuilds from current branch state on contention.
Public projection contains sanitized references/derived state only; no raw/private human payload is added for browser verification.
QA_PENDING never means promoted/current and browser evidence has no CURRENT, HUMAN_ACCEPTED, SERVED-governance or promotion authority.
Representative Chromium runs only after served chat-canary index/progress asset identity and cache-busted version semantics are current.
No separate QA scheduler, browser worker family, version registry, Pages branch or publication workflow is introduced.
acceptance: served chat-canary index is HTTP 200 and corresponds to current main publication intent
served progress-v1.js bytes equal current main and the public index references its content-derived ?v=<sha12>
representative Chromium loads the public chat-canary without page errors
the browser observes a real rendered QA details block produced by the existing async-QA ui_blocks contract
QA_PENDING rendering is evidence/candidate state only and no promoted/current equivalence is introduced
machine-readable evidence records run id, head sha, served identities, interaction assertions, page/console errors and authority boundary
forbidden_regressions: bypassing source/served identity because Playwright can load the page
using local-only DOM fixtures as a substitute for public served interaction
auto-promoting a QA state from verifier evidence
duplicating the existing chat-message-mirror publication owner
rollback: Revert only the served-browser test/evidence additions from the existing chat-message-mirror harness; keep the prior publication/versioning contract unchanged.
truth_boundary: A committed test is not a browser PASS. Completion requires a fresh GitHub Actions run with final enforcement and persisted machine-readable served-browser evidence.
